subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

The tree **__were blowing over__** in the storm.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is **the subject-verb agreement.**
 
• The subject** "tree" **is** singular**, so the verb should also be singular.
 
• The correct verb form should be** "blew over"** to match **the singular subject.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The tree **blew over** in the storm."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "No improvement"** – This option is incorrect because the original sentence has a subject-verb agreement error.
 
• **Option 3: "was blow over"** – This option is incorrect because "was blow over" is not the correct verb form.
 
• **Option 4: "blown over"** – This option is incorrect because "blown over" is a past participle and needs an auxiliary verb to be correct in this context.
